title: Voltmace Delta 14B/1 JOYSTIK driver (© 1983 Custom Video Productions)
notes: Extracted from the Voltmace Delta 14B driver disc (release 1) with oaknut-disc. A *RUN program that loads at &1900 and executes at &1909. Comprises a 6502 joystick driver plus a configuration/demo program written in BBC BASIC. Only a byte-PREFIX of the BASIC is ROL-encoded (rotate-left one bit); the remainder is stored raw ('partly protected').
